programme.title: Big Lizard

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings: World Tour

programme.title: Duck and Frog

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons

programme.title: Winx Club - The Magic Is Back

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: The Eligible Bachelor
programme.desc: 1993. Director: Peter Hammond. Stars Jeremy Brett & Edward Hardwicke. Sherlock Holmes is troubled by disturbing dreams but they prove to aid in the search for a missing bride.

programme.title: The Blue Lagoon
programme.desc: 1980. Drama. Directed by Randal Kleiser. Stars Christopher Atkins, Brooke Shields & Leo McKern. Two children are stranded on an enchanting island and experience the mysteries of adolescence.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Turn of Fate
programme.desc: Circumstantial. 1957. Stars David Niven, Angie Dickinson & Whit Bissell. A prominent lawyer is arrested for murder, however as there is no body, is it circumstantial?

programme.title: Birmingham & The Road Patrol Bikes
programme.desc: Glimpses: 1950s. We start in Birmingham at the famous BSA factory where we follow the annual Road Patrol. Marvel at their side chassis and box carriers and follow them to Exeter, Abroath & Belfast.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: Our Men in Marawat. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Byzantine Treasure. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Discovering King John's mothers stolen money, Robin embarks to return it in a potentially dangerous mission.

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Dan Tempest Holds An Auction. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Ballard Berkeley & Bernard Brown. Tempest takes a solo trip to Charleston, where he hopes to sell an abundance of cargo for a fair fee.

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: False Alarm. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell & Graydon Gould. The Supercar team receives a distress call instigated by Masterspy to rescue two geologists trapped in the mountains.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Count of Twelve. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, John Longden & Genine Graham. Harry Bancroft loses a fortune. An article exposes Graves insider trading, and he starts to receive threatening letters.

programme.title: Account Rendered
programme.desc: 1957. Thriller. Directed by Peter Graham Scott. Stars Honor Blackman, Griffith Jones & Ursula Howells. When a wealthy banker's wife is found murdered, the police find many suspects with a motive.

programme.title: The Breaking Point
programme.desc: 1961. The nephew of a printer gets involved with foreign spies' intent on making counterfeit money. Stars Peter Reynolds & Dermot Walsh.

programme.title: Do You Know This Voice?
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Directed by Frank Nesbitt. Stars Dan Duryea, Isa Miranda, Gwen Watford & Peter Madden. In this great murder mystery, the only clue to the killer's identity is his shoes!

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Family. 1974. Stars David Jackson, Maryann Turner & Kenneth Colley. Susan wants her father back inside and uses two men to help her. One of them is Quilley, but he accidently ruins Skinner's work.

programme.title: Star Performance: The Deceiving Eye
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Alvin Ganzer. Stars Frank Lovejoy & Ann Robinson. A professor works with the police to prove that eyewitnesses can't be trusted, but things take an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Guardsman. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. 28 year old Geoffrey Charles Dean was murdered by a railway fireman who stole £160 from the railway booking office.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Saracen Physician. 1962. Stars Dermot Walsh & Peter Elliott. Unwell with fever, Richard is attended by a physician who, unknown to his friends, is in the pay of Saladin - Richard's enemy.

programme.title: The Spaniard's Curse
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Ralph Kemplen. Stars Tony Wright, Lee Patterson, Michael Hordern & Susan Beaumont. A man of Spanish heritage is convicted of murder & places a curse on the judge & jury.

programme.title: Look At Life Let's Go Dancing
programme.desc: 1959. A look into different styles of dancing and how they have changed. Also, a look at the ballroom championships, showing that, there indeed, is a dance for everybody.

programme.title: Assignment K
programme.desc: 1968. Thriller. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Stephen Boyd, Camilla Sparv & Michael Redgrave. A toy manufacturer, who doubles as a British Intelligence Agent, becomes entangled with European spies.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: In this wonderful music video, Terrie Lomas sings the sensational hit Like I Do.

programme.title: Arsenal Stadium Mystery
programme.desc: 1939. Mystery. Director: Thorold Dickinson. Stars Leslie Banks, Greta Gynt, Ian McLean. Poison, death and mystery set at the Arsenal Stadium. Detective Slade is called to solve the crime.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: The Detectives take a spin along Britain's roads before the invention of the Motorway, they celebrate a century of Elstree Studios & and a young Michael Caine is spotted in a TPTV favourite.

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: The Reluctant Witness. 1993. Stars Bruno Cremer, Denise Chalem & Christiane Cohendy. A call comes in about a murder in the house of Lachaume, but no one in the family is willing to talk.

programme.title: Lost Command
programme.desc: 1966. Action. Director: Mark Robson. Stars Anthony Quinn, Alain Delon & George Segal. French Army colonel Raspeguy leads his paratroopers into battle against the Communist Viet Minh in Indochina.

programme.title: The Lawless Years
programme.desc: The Maxie Gorman Story. 1959. Stars James Gregory, Robert H. Harris & Terence de Marney. Two men join forces to get into the bootlegging business but one man does not want to split the profits.

programme.title: Murders In...
programme.desc: Murders in Maussane - Crime dans les Alpilles. 2017. Director: Eric Duret. Stars Florence Pernel & Vincent Winterhalter. Police are investigating the murder of Caroline Autiero, wife a mill owner.

programme.title: The Devil's Hand
programme.desc: 1961. Horror. Directed by William J. Hole Jr. Stars Linda Christian, Robert Alda & Ariadne Welter. A man, haunted by visions of a beautiful woman, winds up in a Satanic cult after meeting her.

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: It's time to get into the groove with Ain't Gonna Kiss Ya performed by the internationally acclaimed harmony band - The Fortunes.

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: The Vestris. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Torin Thatcher & Rita Lynn. A ship captain's wife has a vivid vision at sea urging him to change course before tragedy strikes.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: Grave Doubts. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen.

programme.title: Model For Murder
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Directed by Terry Bishop. Stars Keith Andes, Hazel Court, Michael Gough, Julia Arnall & Patricia Jessel. A Mayfair dress designer arranges for the theft of valuable jewellery.

programme.title: Happy In The Morning 1938
programme.desc: Enjoy this musical short film from 1938 with fascinating footage from a circus and a charming song at the swing nightclub.

programme.title: Meet Mr Callaghan
programme.desc: 1954. Crime drama directed by Charles Saunders. Private detective Slim Callaghan (Derrick De Marney) is hired to find out why a rich uncle changed his will.

programme.title: The Spider and the Fly
programme.desc: 1949. Crime. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Eric Portman, Nadia Gray & George Cole. An unusual love triangle develops between two criminals and a policeman on the eve of the first World War.

programme.title: Star Performance: Young Girl in an Apple Tree
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Peter Godfrey. Stars Ann Harding & Regis Toomey. The owner of a gift shop decides to search for her former admirer who had left their town long ago.

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: Death on the Underground. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham & Alan Moss. The murder of 73 year old aristocrat Countess Teresa Lubienska on the eastbound Piccadilly line platform in 1957.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Shrew. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Hedda, lured away by a message that her sister is ill, finds herself an unwilling pawn in Gessler's latest plot.

programme.title: Home and Away
programme.desc: 1956. Drama directed by Vernon Sewell and starring Jack Warner, Thora Hird, Harry Fowler and Kathleen Harrison. Based on 'The Huggetts' family rivalry when two sons win the football pools.

programme.title: Jodie Foster: Hollywood Under the Skin
programme.desc: 2021. Director: Camille Juza & Yal Sadat. From her precocious status as a sex symbol to her consecration as a filmmaker, Jodie Foster's story is a feminist struggle, fought on and off screen.

programme.title: Doctor In Clover
programme.desc: 1966. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars James Robertson Justice, Leslie Phillips, Shirley Anne Field. Gaston Grimsdyke enrols on a medical course run by Sir Lancelot Spratt.

programme.title: Look A Life In The Swim
programme.desc: 1960. An investigative look at the tropical fish industry; where do they come from and where do they go?

programme.title: Whiplash
programme.desc: Storm River. 1961. Peter Graves, Annette Andre, Grant Taylor. Cobb is knocked out during a storm and awakens in a outback cabin where he finds his moneybelt has been taken.

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: Alexander the Great Affair: Part Two. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. Solo, Kuryakin and Tracey escape Alexander's death trap. Solo is menaced by a muscular thug.

programme.title: Buccaneer
programme.desc: Albatross. 1980. Stars Bryan Marshall, Clifford Rose & Pamela Salem. Burton reshapes the company and ''special cargo'' looms. Personal complications arrive for Tony.

programme.title: Night of the Eagle
programme.desc: 1962. Horror. Director: Sidney Hayers. Stars Peter Wyngarde, Janet Blair & Margaret Johnston. A woman, who may be a witch, defends her husband from forces attempting to harm him.

programme.title: Fortean TV
